s1.explanation: The unit responds to a single real, full-size road vehicle seen whole from the side or front three-quarter angle, with its body and wheels clearly visible, usually parked on pavement in daylight. Red or orange bodywork (red wagons, fire engines, the orange moving van, the red pickup) adds to its activity. Its activity is low for toys, models and cakes, for interior or cargo-area views, for tight crops of the hood or front, for cluttered scenes with several vehicles (buses in a depot, cars on a carrier) and for vehicles blocked by people or darkness. Unlike similar units, it prefers clean full-profile shots (the classic pickup, moving van and jeep) over front close-ups, interiors and crowded vehicle scenes.

s2.explanation: Responds to a single real, full-size road vehicle seen whole in side or three-quarter profile, with body and wheels visible, parked or driving on pavement in daylight. It is strongest when the body is red or orange: red wagon, fire engines, orange moving van, red pickup and red jeep score highest. It is weak for toys, models and cakes, for close-up crops or interior views, for night scenes, and for cluttered scenes with many small vehicles. Compared with similar units, it prefers red/orange vehicle bodies in full side view and dislikes pale-blue or blue vehicles and partial or interior views.

s3.explanation: The unit responds to a single real, full-size road vehicle (car, wagon, fire engine, van, pickup) shown whole in side or three-quarter view, with its body and wheels clearly visible, standing on pavement. It is strongest for red or orange bodies and boxy or older styling. It is weak for toys, models and cakes, for interiors or cropped front close-ups, for scenes where people dominate, and for scenes of many small or distant vehicles such as buses in a depot or cars on a carrier. Compared with the similar units, it prefers the full side profile with wheels over front or detail close-ups.

real_s2.explanation: The unit responds to a whole road vehicle seen from the side or in three-quarter view, with its body and wheels visible, as opposed to cropped close-ups, front-only views or interiors.

real_s3.explanation: The unit responds to a single road vehicle that dominates the photo, shown whole in side or three-quarter view with its body and wheels visible, rather than cropped front, interior or detail close-ups or scenes where people or other objects compete with it.

null_s1.explanation: The unit is most active on photos of road vehicles (the top classes include pickups, moving vans, jeeps, fire engines and wagons), but none of the proposed within-class features explains its activity.

null_s2.explanation: The unit appears to respond to road vehicles as a category (cars, trucks, vans, fire engines and similar). None of the finer preferences in the description hold up, including red/orange color, side view, or real versus toy.

null_s3.explanation: The unit most likely responds to road vehicles in general (cars, vans, trucks, fire engines) at the level of photo class. None of the finer preferences in the description hold: framing, real versus toy, red color and the vehicle dominating the scene do not explain its activity.
